_metadata.description: Publication-based benchmark catalogue for M1-M8 (2026-10-26). Published values only; no engine output. Generated by docs/analysis-redesign/scripts/publication_benchmark.py.

delta_gl.reason: Guo-Liu radii: the authors' radius precision (0.1 pm, see M3 investigation) vs the stored 0.01 pm

delta_cn12.reason: Kittel CN12 radii are integer pm in both; residual = authors' rounding of compositions

dhmix.reason: Takeuchi & Inoue integer table: only composition rounding remains

omega.reason: Yang & Zhang's elemental melting points differ from the stored set by a few K

lambda.reason: Lambda = dS/delta^2 inherits twice the relative radius-precision error of delta

s_e.reason: S_E is a small difference of large terms; radius precision is amplified

phi_ye.reason: phi = (S_c - S_H)/|S_E| inherits the S_E amplification

k1cr.reason: k1cr uses dHmix; Senkov's printed dHmix differs from Takeuchi in some rows (audit section 8)

k1.reason: k1 = dH_IM/dHmix; Senkov's own dHmix column is not the Takeuchi value in every row

king_dg.reason: King used Bakker-tabulated dH_inter (integers) where we evaluate the Miedema equation

king_dgint.reason: as king_dg; ordered-compound prefactor c vs c^s (audit section 3)

king_phi.reason: ratio of two quantities each within king_dg

hf.reason: published matrix cells are stored verbatim

gamma.reason: Guo-Liu radius precision (0.01 vs 0.1 pm) moves gamma by <= 5e-4; compositions reconstructed
